title: Envelope
description: The fields every stored document carries, whatever its entity. Not a collection's schema itself: each entity's schema refers to these fields one by one.

_id.description: Internal to MongoDB and never exposed: the entity's public ID is a field of its own.

orgId.description: The ID of the organisation that submitted the request.

requestId.description: The `x-request-id` the API returned to the request that created the document. Never changed, so it links the documents one request created.

revision.description: The document's revision: 0 when it's created. It will be driven by a history collection once documents can be updated.

updatedAt.description: When the document was last written; its createdAt until it's updated.

payload.description: The request body as UTF-8 JSON: the parsed body serialised again, so the same data as sent though not necessarily the same bytes. Never queried or edited; the other fields can be worked out from it again.

payloadHash.description: SHA-256, as hex, of the request body's JSON with every object's keys sorted: the same however a resubmission orders or spaces its keys, so it tells the same request sent again from a different one.
